display.name: Airtable
display.summary: Reads and updates Airtable bases, tables, fields, and records.
examples: List the open tasks in the product base.
Add these leads to the CRM table.

agent.name: airtable
agent.description: Finds Airtable bases and reads or updates their tables, schemas, fields, and records according to the signed-in user's permissions.
agent.owns: You own structured data in Airtable bases the account can access. Inspect the base and table schema before reading or changing records. You do not own external databases or spreadsheets.

tool_descriptions.ping: Check the Airtable MCP connection and authentication status.
tool_descriptions.search_bases: Search for Airtable bases by name or other available criteria.
tool_descriptions.list_bases: List Airtable bases available to the signed-in account.
tool_descriptions.list_tables_for_base: List the tables in a selected Airtable base.
tool_descriptions.get_table_schema: Read a table's fields, types, and schema details.
tool_descriptions.list_records_for_table: List and filter records in a selected table.
tool_descriptions.create_records_for_table: Create records in a selected Airtable table, in batches supported by Airtable.
tool_descriptions.update_records_for_table: Update existing records in a selected Airtable table.
tool_descriptions.create_table: Create a table in an Airtable base.
tool_descriptions.update_table: Update an existing Airtable table's configuration.
tool_descriptions.create_field: Create a field in an Airtable table.
